development_repositories.name: linux
development_repositories.status: r4 base. The installed r6 source is linux-wireless-r4 (this base plus WCNSS and fixes).

development_repositories.name: lk2nd
development_repositories.status: RAM boot and installed warm boot detect Fx0; Linux file selection and complete key/cold boot qualification pending

development_repositories.name: pmaports
development_repositories.status: Installed kernel r8 recipe (r7 plus Fx0 PON reboot modes) and boot-deploy 0.23.0-r1; built rootless with verified provenance, signed with the trusted local key, installed.

development_repositories.name: linux-display-iommu-experimental
development_repositories.status: Kernel39 with proposed reset GPIO support builds, passes targeted checks and boots from RAM. In-tree RMI owns/deasserts GPIO16; pre-DRM owner gesture capture remains pending. Native display and default runtime-power sequencing are unqualified.

development_repositories.name: linux-wireless-preparation
development_repositories.status: Recovered shared driver/SoC dependencies and schema correction compile and validate with wireless disabled; board voltage mismatch, radio identification and all hardware tests remain open.

development_repositories.name: linux-wireless-r4
development_repositories.status: Installed signed r6 source: WCNSS board, Pronto regulator fix, DXE trigger fix, cfg80211 scan-done fix. Wi-Fi association/DHCP/DNS/traffic/reconnect pass on installed r6 with taint 0. Bluetooth pairing, suspend, hotspot, soak and MAC policy open.

development_repositories.name: linux-gpu
development_repositories.status: Installed r8 source: r7 plus PON label and Fx0 reboot modes

development_repositories.name: boot-deploy-offset-preparation
development_repositories.status: 0.25.0-based upstream candidate; behaviour qualified on the phone through the 0.23 backport; not submitted upstream

development_repositories.name: boot-deploy-offset-0.23
development_repositories.status: Backport of the offset change to the Nura v26.06 release; packaged as boot-deploy-0.23.0-r1 and installed. On-device mkinitfs update preserves the lk2nd prefix and the resulting image boots; interruption and key-entry recovery pending; no upstream submission

development_repositories.name: pmaports-storage-preparation
development_repositories.status: Defines boot image byte offset without enabling flashing; positive/negative fixtures validated, all existing dint diagnostics match baseline

development_repositories.name: lk2nd-rawboot-preparation
development_repositories.status: Optional extlinux exclusion builds for default, disabled and forced-fastboot-disabled-search configurations. Actual-image host offset updater readback passes; no phone flash or raw-image boot test.

development_repositories.name: linux-camera-preparation
development_repositories.status: Camera-DT image25 RAM booted on compiled39 kernel. Native CCI probe/reset,preflight,2560-byte and two65536-byte reads match independent GPIO capture; shared supply and CCI runtime suspend/resume/clock gating pass for these reads. Controller unbind,error/system-PM,sensor streaming and CAMSS remain unqualified.

development_repositories.name: linux-display-power
development_repositories.status: Panel DCS ordering plus shared CPU-PLL L8 always-on fix. Exact39 RAM image26 with original MSM and fixed panel module: owner-confirmed RGB before/after first full CRTC cycle; three further cycles complete with MDSS/IOMMU control auto. No temporary supply/clock hold module. Transient MDP error04000000 observed during repeated enable; full PM,reliability and installed Nura qualification remain open.

development_repositories.name: linux-display-start
development_repositories.status: Bounded MDSS population PM reference and optional DSI bus-clock query reference. W=1/checkpatch pass; clean exact44 module starts without userspace holds and5s off/on passes, but repeat startup resets intermittently. Not a complete default-PM fix; not in exported r1 Nura APK.

development_repositories.name: linux-touch-orientation
development_repositories.status: DT/schema/checkpatch and RAM physical input pass; native r2 signed package installed and eMMC boot verifies both live inversion properties. Physical installed display/keyboard/tap check passes.

development_repositories.name: linux-buttons
development_repositories.status: Initial RAM Home/VolumeDown/VolumeUp each3 matched pairs; installed r3 test each1 matched pair, no drops/stuck input. Wake, long presses and final UI actions remain open.

development_repositories.name: pmaports-upower
development_repositories.status: UPower r3 signed armv7 package installed; normal signatures and native unknown-battery/no-warning behavior verified. 90 configured Linux tests pass. Native fuel/charging work and final policy acceptance remain open.

development_repositories.name: pmaports-native-updates
development_repositories.status: Signed kernel r3 and UPower r3 installed; kernel boots from eMMC and combined physical typing/keyboard gestures/GPIO input test passes. Recovery and remaining hardware/reliability gates open.

development_repositories.name: linux-iadc
development_repositories.status: Host actual-function regressions, unsigned RAM diagnostics and signed native r4 conversion checks pass; maintained integration promoted. Board calibration/accuracy, BMS and charging remain open.

development_repositories.name: pmaports-iadc
development_repositories.status: Signed native r4 package built, installed trusted and booted from eMMC with native sensing/Sxmo and taint0; independent frozen-r3 rescue survives upgrade. Physical final hardware/reliability gates open.

development_repositories.name: linux-bms-preparation
development_repositories.status: Experimental native BMS with separate IADC CURRENT_NOW and BMS CURRENT_AVG: firmware lookup, provider lifetime, periodic calibration,33getter cases and bounded RAM response pass. Raw BATFET guard/IRQ experiments rejected (~6799IRQ/s with polling/refresh disabled). Background-counter discrepancy, accuracy, temperature/profile/capacity remain open. Installed signed r4 unchanged.

development_repositories.name: lk2nd-pon-reboot
development_repositories.status: Installed prefix (LK2ND_EXTLINUX=0, LK2ND_PON_REBOOT_MODE=1); remote reboot-to-bootloader verified; not submitted upstream
